episode: Guff — Mercy and Twisted Eel Cross-links

changes.name: Mercy Vale
changes.append_entry: Guff, Mercy’s enormous old brindled war hound, is rarely far from her. Age has made him flea-bitten, grey-muzzled, and fond of sleeping through most trouble, but he remains fiercely protective of Mercy and surprisingly affectionate with people he accepts.
changes.append_marker: Guff, Mercy’s enormous old brindled war hound

changes.name: The Twisted Eel Pawnshop
changes.append_entry: Guff, Mercy’s scarred old war hound, is as much a fixture of the Eel as the pawn counter. He can usually be found asleep somewhere inconvenient, accepting scraps and scratches from people he knows; anyone threatening Mercy may discover that the old dog still has some war left in him.
changes.append_marker: Guff, Mercy’s scarred old war hound
